integrity: Proof is self-contained aside from a cited classical positive stable heat-kernel two-sided bound. Numerical checks are supplementary. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Fixed 1<p<2; finite cycles with N divisible by 4; leading last-failure constant and one-frequency critical window; not full finite-size threshold correction or all N.
title: A sharp logarithmic positivity-recovery law for fractional powered-exponential kernels on finite cycles
